ko.name: QURATOR — Daily Art
ko.subtitle: QR 도슨트 · 오늘의 명작과 영어 해설
ko.description:
작품 옆 QR을 찍으면 해설이 텍스트와 음성으로 열립니다.
매일 한 점의 명작을 영어 해설, 한국어 번역, 도슨트 음성으로 소개합니다.

· QR 스캔: 전시장의 QURATOR QR을 앱으로 바로 읽기
· 오늘의 작품: 매일 한 점, 영어 해설 + 한국어 번역 + 오늘의 영어 표현
· 특집: 지금 미술계에서 화제인 작품을 미술사의 눈으로
· 탐색: 시카고 미술관·클리블랜드 미술관 공개 소장품 검색
· 지난 작품 모아 보기

QURATOR의 나눔은 오리엘 재단을 통해 도움이 필요한 가정과 사랑스런 아이들에게 전해질 예정입니다(재단 등록 후 집행).
ko.promo: 작품 옆 QR 하나로 해설·음성·영어 표현까지. 매일 한 점, 명작과 친해지는 시간.
ko.whatsNew: 새 로고로 바뀌었어요. 둥근 액자 속 Q 아이콘과 새 앱 화면으로 단장했습니다.

review.notes:
1. SCREEN RECORDING (physical iPhone, latest iOS): https://probe2928-crypto.github.io/qurator/review/qurator-ios-1.0.0.mp4
(Recorded on iPhone with TestFlight build 1.0.0 (15): launch from TestFlight → Today's artwork → narration in viewing mode with captions → voice switch → back to text and return to viewing mode → menu, Features, Explore → QR scan of a test code shown on another device → the scanned artwork opens and plays. The recording has no sound because the phone was in silent mode; the captions follow the narration as it plays.)

2. PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
QURATOR is a free art docent app. Visitors at galleries and exhibitions scan the QR code placed next to an artwork and the app opens that work's commentary as text and narrated audio, in Korean and English. "Daily Art" introduces one public-domain masterpiece every day with English commentary, a Korean translation and an English expression of the day.
Audience: gallery and museum visitors, art lovers, and adults in Korea who want to learn English through art.
Problem it solves: small galleries cannot afford audio-guide devices; with QURATOR every visitor's own phone becomes the docent, and art lovers get a short, trustworthy daily art lesson.

3. HOW TO USE (no login, no account, no purchases)
- Launch the app: the Today screen shows today's artwork. Tap it to read the commentary; tap the play button to hear the narration.
- QR scan: tap the QR button at the top right, allow camera access, and scan this test code: https://probe2928-crypto.github.io/qurator/assets/review/qr-w-kandinsky7.png (opens Kandinsky, Composition VII). Any artwork page URL can be turned into a QR code the same way.
- Other tabs: Features (long-form articles), Explore (search public museum collections), Archive (recent daily works), Giving (our charity partner page), Support (KakaoTalk chat link, opens in the in-app browser).

4. EXTERNAL SERVICES
- Our own website on GitHub Pages (probe2928-crypto.github.io/qurator): artwork data (JSON) and pre-recorded narration audio files.
- Artwork images and search: Wikimedia Commons, Art Institute of Chicago API, Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access API (public-domain / CC0 images).
- Narration audio (male and female voices) and soft background music are produced in advance on our build server: narration with text-to-speech, music performed by us from public-domain scores or composed by us. Nothing is generated inside the app.
- Apple's camera via the Capacitor barcode scanner plugin, used only to read QR codes (no photos are stored or sent).
- No login/authentication service, no payment processor, no analytics, no ads, no AI service in the app.

5. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
None. The app works the same in every region; the interface is available in Korean and English.

6. THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL / REGULATION
Not a regulated industry. All artworks shown are in the public domain (artists died more than 70 years ago) and the images come from museum open-access programs (CC0) or Wikimedia Commons public-domain files. All commentary text is our own original writing.
